parameters.name: ClusterResourceId
parameters.description:
The resource ID of the hybrid cloud cluster.
> Call the [DescribeHybridCloudClusters](~~2849376~~) operation and find the target hybrid cloud cluster in the **ClusterInfos** array of the response. Use the value of the **ClusterResourceId** field. If no cluster is available, call the [CreateHybridCloudCluster](~~2980286~~) operation to create a hybrid cloud cluster.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the WAF instance.

> Call the [DescribeInstanceInfo](~~140857~~) operation to query the ID of the current WAF instance.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: ResourceManagerResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.

parameters.name: RuleStatus
parameters.description:
The enabling status of the manual bypass switch. Valid values:

- **on**: enabled.

- **off (default)**: shutdown.
